alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A dark room. A small amber block figure with white eyes stands on the left facing a counter on the right that reads EP 1. The counter climbs EP 2, EP 3, EP 4, EP 5, EP 6 while the figure leans a little more each time and its eyes get sleepier. In the last seconds the text changes from: me watching just one episode, to: are you still watching? The figure's eyes go wide and it trembles. It narrows its eyes at the camera.
